topic: A fresh Codex task's session gets no pin
detail: SP-029 pins a queued task's agent session to its dispatch space when the agent process starts. A Claude Code task's session ID is known in advance (agentrun.SessionID) and a resumed Codex run's thread is stored, but a fresh Codex run learns its thread ID only when it ends, so it gets no pin: its transcript, record and summary are quarantined under a policy, and while the guard enforces its tool calls are refused as pin_missing (RC-100 stays open for it). Proposed: have the Codex runner report the thread ID as soon as thread.started arrives (update LiveRun.SessionID and call OnLive), so orchd can pin it like a Claude task.
